summary.name: SmartGit
summary.one_liner: SmartGit is a cross-platform visual Git client for desktop that supports the full Git workflow from cloning to pushing.
use_cases: managing git branches and merges visually
cloning repositories from GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket or Azure DevOps
summary.what_it_does: SmartGit is a graphical Git client that runs on Windows, macOS, and Linux. It lets users clone an existing repository or initialize a new one, and manage commits, branches, and merges through a graphical interface. It includes tools to review changes, resolve merge conflicts, and keep history clean. Users can open local repos or clone from GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, or Azure DevOps, then commit locally and push changes. The page presents testimonials on use with multiple clients, code review of large files, and submodules in game development, but gives no technical specifics beyond these.
notable: Visual graphical Git interface for the full workflow
Connects directly to GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, and Azure DevOps
caveats: Pricing and license terms are not stated on the page
Page is mostly marketing; few technical details given
